summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue of unclosed database connections in ThreadedWSGIServer by ensuring connections are closed after each request. However, it introduces a potential performance regression and may not be the most minimal solution.

issues.description: Closing database connections after each request can introduce performance overhead, especially in scenarios with high request volumes.

The change could be more minimal by targeting the specific issue rather than modifying the base server class. It might be better to handle connection closure within the context of the test server lifecycle.
